title: T331 expiry or stop
text: 1 >  if T331 expires or is stopped:

NOTE: It is up to UE implementation whether to continue idle/inactive measurements according to SIB11 and SIB4 configurations or according to E-UTRA SIB5 and E-UTRA SIB24 configurations as specified in TS 36.331 upon inter-RAT cell reselection to E-UTRA, after T331 has expired or stopped.
